trans-unit.source: Translate automatically: Run Supertext AI translation whenever pages or content elements are localized.

Supertext API key: No Supertext account yet? Create one at https://www.supertext.com/person/en/account/signin . Generate your API key at supertext.com > Integrations > API (https://www.supertext.com/en/integrations/api, requires the Admin role). The environment variable SUPERTEXT_API_KEY takes precedence.
API environment
Custom API base URL: Overrides the environment when set (e.g. https://api.supertext.com/v1/).
Polling timeout (seconds): Maximum time to wait for a translation.
Polling interval (seconds)
Skip bodytext for these content types: Comma-separated CTypes whose bodytext is code, not prose.
Regenerate page slugs: Build the URL segment of a translated page from its translated title.

Generate your API key at https://www.supertext.com/en/integrations/api (supertext.com → Integrations → API, requires the Admin role) and enter it in the extension configuration.

Status: The latest Supertext API key check, the version information setting and how the site languages map to Supertext languages.

Send version information to Supertext: Sends the site URL and the versions of this extension, TYPO3 and the runtime to Supertext when you save these settings and after an update, so Supertext support can see which version you run. No content, no API key and no personal data are sent. The environment variable SUPERTEXT_VERSION_REPORTS=0 turns it off and takes precedence.

The language Supertext translates into (for the default language: from). Default uses the code shown for the locale: its exact Supertext code, or the usual one (de → de-DE, nl_NL → nl, zh_TW → zh-Hant). Locales without one show “— choose —”: translations into such a language stop with a message until you choose its Supertext language.
